name: Vale Loaf
description: Merrowby bread from the blue-door mill's flour. Still the measure of whether a village is being tended: if the bread is good, so is the talk.

name: Tamwick Cider
description: From the only cider press in Wickmere. Tamwick says one cup makes you honest and two make you a Sayer.

name: Gullhithe Eel Pie
description: Lake-eel in a hot-water crust, sold on Tollmere's quays by the tally. Clerks eat them standing up.

name: Clan Oatcake
description: Skerrow oats baked hard on a griddle. Keeps for a season in a satchel and is remembered fondly by nobody.

name: Roast Mutton
description: Heather-fed Skerrow mutton. The clans roast a whole one when a name is added to the Moot.

name: Pilgrim's Ash-Cake
description: Flatbread baked in Cinderlea's warm ash. It tastes of nothing much, which the Order counts as a mercy.

name: Raw Meat
description: Cut from a wolf or a bristleback. Better roasted over a hearth, where somebody can ask you where you got it.
